messages:
alex: Heads-up — spotted a broken link in the runtime guide: /docs/runtime/kv-cache which 404s. Could someone own a quick PR?

sarah: I can take this. Which exact section is it in?

jordan: It's under 'KV Caching' in the performance tips section — the diagram link to our assets bucket returns 403. File path is `docs/runtime/kv-cache.md`.

alex: Failing link: https://assets.redwood.ai/docs/runtime/kv-cache-diagram.png -> 403. Likely an S3 permission or we should rehost on the docs CDN.

devex-bot: Automated scan scn-2026-0420 flagged this thread. Suggested next steps: rehost asset, update markdown, add `docs: quick-fix` label, and run the docs image health check.

mike: @sarah if you want the expedited path, open a PR titled `docs: rehost kv-cache diagram` and add the `docs: quick-fix` label. I'll do a rapid review.

sarah: Starting a branch now. Plan: upload image to https://cdn.redwoodusercontent.com/ and update the markdown link + alt text. Pinging @liz for a tiny copy tweak.

liz: Happy to do copy nits in the PR. Also can we update the paragraph to point at the current model-onboarding guide URL while we're here?

sarah: Yep. Will replace the stale onboarding link and add alt text. WIP PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/1427

alex: Quick QA ask — can we add a lightweight regression check that curls images referenced in docs during the build so 403s/404s fail CI? Even a single step would help catch these.

jordan: +1. I'll add a small job to the release pipeline that `curl -f` each image URL found by a grep. Low-risk.

mike: Review estimate 30m. @sarah add me as reviewer and include the sed one-liner you used. :thumbsup:

sarah: Added you as reviewer. PR description includes this sed snippet for bulk-replace: ```sed -i 's|https://assets.redwood.ai/|https://cdn.redwoodusercontent.com/|' docs/runtime/kv-cache.md```

alex: Also please add a bullet to the `docs-sprint-2026-04` release notes summarizing the fix.

devex-bot: Reminder: If this changes file ownership, add `owner: docs` to the frontmatter or update the CODEOWNERS file.

liz: LGTM once the copy tweak is applied.

mike: Reviewing now, should be quick.
